lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 1 — Jesus Taken Up Into Heaven / Matthias Chosen

questions.questionText: I wrote the first book about what Jesus began to do and to teach. Who am I?
Who is the book of Acts written to?
Until what day did Luke write about Jesus in his first book?
options: Until Jesus was taken up to heaven

questions.questionText: Through whom did Jesus give instructions to the apostles he had chosen?
For how many days did Jesus appear to the apostles after his suffering?
After his suffering, what did Jesus give the apostles to show he was alive?
Who said, “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised”?
Where did Jesus tell the apostles not to leave?
Jesus said John baptized with water, but in a few days they would be baptized with the _____.
Who asked, “Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?”
Who said, “It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority”?
Jesus said, “You will receive _____ when the Holy Spirit comes on you.”
Jesus said they would be his witnesses first in which city?
After Jerusalem, where else did Jesus say they would be witnesses?
options: In all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth

questions.questionText: What happened after Jesus finished speaking in verse 8?
options: He sat down to eat again
He was taken up, and a cloud hid him
He walked back to the city

questions.questionText: We suddenly stood beside the apostles, dressed in white, as they looked at the sky. Who are we?
Who said, “Men of Galilee, why do you stand here looking into the sky?”
How did the two men say Jesus will come back?
options: In the same way they saw him go into heaven

questions.questionText: From which hill did the apostles return to Jerusalem?
How far was the Mount of Olives from the city?
Where did the apostles go when they arrived back in Jerusalem?
options: Upstairs to the room where they were staying

questions.questionText: I am listed first among the apostles in the upstairs room. Who am I?
I am called “the Zealot” in the list of apostles. Who am I?
Who joined the apostles constantly in prayer in the upstairs room?
options: The women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers

questions.questionText: I am the mother of Jesus and I prayed with the believers. Who am I?
About how many believers were in the group when Peter stood up?
Who stood up among the believers and began to speak?
Who said the Scripture had to be fulfilled about Judas?
I served as guide for those who arrested Jesus. Who am I?
True or false: Judas had been one of the apostles and shared in their ministry.
options: False — he was only a soldier

questions.questionText: What did Judas buy with the payment he received for his wickedness?
What happened to Judas in that field?
options: He fell headlong, and his body burst open

questions.questionText: What did people in Jerusalem call the field Judas bought?
options: Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood

questions.questionText: Who said it is written in the Book of Psalms, “May another take his place of leadership”?
options: David speaking in person that day

questions.questionText: Who did Peter say the Holy Spirit spoke through long ago about Judas?
What kind of man did they need to choose to replace Judas?
options: A man who had been with them the whole time Jesus was living among them

questions.questionText: From what event to what event did the new apostle need to have been with them?
options: From John’s baptism to the time Jesus was taken up
From the flood to the tower of Babel

questions.questionText: What must the new man become with the other apostles?
I was nominated with Matthias. I am also called Justus. Who am I?
I was the other man nominated besides Joseph called Barsabbas. Who am I?
Who prayed, “Lord, you know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen”?
options: Only Peter alone without the others

questions.questionText: What ministry did they ask the Lord to give to the one he chose?
options: The work of a fisherman only
This apostolic ministry which Judas left
The work of a Roman guard

questions.questionText: How did they decide between Joseph and Matthias?
options: They flipped a coin from Rome

questions.questionText: Who was added to the eleven apostles?
True or false: After the lot fell, there were twelve apostles again.
options: True — Matthias was added to the eleven
